```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(leaflet)

# Coordinates
bangkok <- c(lat = 13.7563, lng = 100.5018)
melbourne <- c(lat = -37.8136, lng = 144.9631)

# Create line from Bangkok to Melbourne
route <- data.frame(
  lng = c(bangkok["lng"], melbourne["lng"]),
  lat = c(bangkok["lat"], melbourne["lat"])
)

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = 122, lat = -12, zoom = 3) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = bangkok["lng"],
    lat = bangkok["lat"],
    label = "Bangkok, Thailand",
    radius = 6,
    fillOpacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = melbourne["lng"],
    lat = melbourne["lat"],
    label = "Melbourne, Australia",
    radius = 6,
    fillOpacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  addPolylines(
    data = route,
    lng = ~lng,
    lat = ~lat,
    weight = 3,
    opacity = 0.8,
    label = "Bangkok to Melbourne"
  ) |>
  addControl(
    html = "<strong>From accounting and finance in Thailand<br>to business analytics in Australia</strong>",
    position = "bottomleft"
  )
```
